messages:
lee: Has anyone seen my Pixel Pacific mug? blue with a tiny pixel wave. vanished from desk this morning. :sob:

anita: oh no! is it the one with the chip on the rim? i remember it looked like a tiny smile.

devon: rumor: there is a mug shrine under meeting-room C. i saw something glittering during lunch. :eyes: 

lee: not funny. that mug contains my life-force (and coffee).

morgan: i solemnly swear i did not kidnap any mugs. but i might have borrowed an extra spoon. :sweat_smile:

ops-bot: Note: If you suspect item theft, please file a report with lost-and-found using /lostfound <item> so facilities can investigate. Automated reminders will be sent at 24h and 72h.

anita: classic ops-bot. bureaucracy, but fair.

devon: update: i peeked under meeting-room C during standup. there is indeed a tiny altar made of sticky notes. offerings include: a half-eaten granola bar, three paperclips, and one mug (unlabeled).

lee: can you confirm the mug is Pixel Pacific? any pixel-wave motif?

devon: no visible wave, but there is a sticker that reads "property of the Mug Collective" and a Post-It: "for the chosen sipper."

morgan: the Mug Collective?? new cult at Redwood? do we get rituals and robes?

anita: we should form a Mug Registry. photo + short blurb = return priority. prevents future cult escalations.

lee: i will sign up. photo incoming. *posts picture link* (sorry, imagelink)

devon: wow that is definitely your mug, lee. i can see the tiny chip that looks like a smile. confession: i felt emotional.

lee: reclaim ritual ideas: 1) perform a haiku 2) recite the coffee oath 3) present a fresh spoon as tribute.

morgan: proposal: sash for the reclaimed mug-bearer. embroidered with "Official Sipper".

anita: sash + tiny nameplate on the mug. also a tiny engraved base for the shrine reading "Returned to rightful hands."

ops-bot: Facilities update: Mug left in communal spaces without label will be placed in lost-and-found after 48 hours. Please label personal items.

devon: quick poll: which reclaim ritual? react with :one: haiku, :two: coffee oath, :three: spoon tribute

lee: also awarding a new nickname to the thief (if found): "Kettle Bandit." low stakes but dramatic.

morgan: :one: for haiku. i will write a dramatic one.

anita: :two: for coffee oath. solemn.

devon: tallying: one=2, two=1, three=0. haiku wins.

lee: ok fine. haiku is accepted. i will retrieve my mug and deliver my haiku to the altar. photo required.

morgan: for posterity, please include a close-up of the tiny chip-of-smile. archival quality. :camera_with_flash:

ops-bot: Friendly reminder: labeling items with name and team reduces shrine formation. This is an automated note.

lee: thanks all. saga concluded (for now). if anyone sees a suspiciously smug spoonsmith, tell them i want my mug back.

anita: victory parade pending. i will bring confetti and a tiny flag.
__notes: Single Slack thread string, messages in chronological order, prefixed by sender names. No title field included per agents.md.
